newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close lower on thin volume.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close lower on thin volume.

text.p: 1030 GMT - Polish shares extended their two-session fall in lower turnover with selling stronger after the price fixing.
* The main market's WIG index closed 279.4 points, or 1.7 percent, lower at 15,899.6, the WIG 20 fell 1.3 percent to 1,590.4 and the parallel market's WIRR fell 2.5 percent to 3,458.9.

* Turnover fell 6.6 percent to 131 million zlotys on all three markets as 83 issues fell, eight rose and nine were flat. Most active Mostostal Export fell 4.4 percent in a nine-million-zloty turnover. Electrodes maker ZEW started bourse trade at 36 zlotys, 20 percent below the issue price.
